summary: Comprehensive testing of Pop Off dating app with swipe/match system and AI moderation. Backend APIs are functional (92% success rate), but critical frontend authentication issues prevent full e2e testing of dating features.

flaky_endpoints.issue: Returns 520 error instead of 500 - server configuration issue
flaky_endpoints.impact: Video chat tokens cannot be generated
flaky_endpoints.note: Expected failure due to missing Agora configuration

minor_issues.impact: No functional impact, just warning messages

critical_bugs.issue: Signup and login forms do not redirect users after successful authentication
critical_bugs.details: API calls succeed (200 status) but frontend remains on login page
critical_bugs.impact: Users cannot access any dating app features after signup/login

critical_bugs.issue: Authentication state not properly maintained in frontend
critical_bugs.details: All protected routes redirect to login even after successful API authentication
critical_bugs.impact: Cannot test any dating app pages (SwipeMatch, Matches, Chat, ProfileSetup)

integration_issues.issue: Cookie/session handling not working between frontend and backend
integration_issues.details: Backend APIs work correctly with session tokens, but frontend not storing/sending them

passed_tests: Backend profile management (get interests, update profile)
Backend matching system (get suggestions, swipe actions)
Backend chat system (get matches, send messages, access control)
Backend content moderation (report submission, AI processing)
Frontend React app loading and compilation
Frontend route protection (correctly redirects to login)
Frontend form rendering (signup/login forms display correctly)

action_item_for_main_agent.priority_1: Fix frontend authentication flow - signup/login success should redirect users to dashboard/profile-setup
action_item_for_main_agent.priority_2: Fix frontend session/cookie management - ensure authentication state persists after login
action_item_for_main_agent.priority_3: Implement proper error handling in frontend auth forms
action_item_for_main_agent.details: Backend APIs are working perfectly. The issue is in frontend JavaScript authentication handling. Users can signup/login via API but frontend doesn't handle the successful response correctly.
